verdict.rationale: Bento documents event-triggered workflows with delays and branching, sequences with timed delays, and scheduling of one-time broadcast sends via the API. The homepage hints at scripting 'the job you run every week' through its CLI and API. Nothing in the evidence shows a native recurring or cron-style schedule trigger, so recurring jobs appear to need an external scheduler driving the CLI, SDK or API. Missing for 10: native recurring/cron schedule triggers for workflows or broadcasts, documented recurring-job setup, independent corroboration.
